name: digital-brain-buddy
description: Repo-local buddy-session plugin for the avatar_digital_brain persona, SOUL file, Neo4j MCP memory workflow, first-run initiate protocol, FEEDBACK gotcha sensors, and guided report-only maintenance.

interface.shortDescription: Buddy persona with Neo4j memory and guided maintenance
interface.longDescription: Run a direct, pattern-aware buddy session on top of the avatar_digital_brain memory graph. The default internal pattern is: main session agent keeps the conversation, a reader gathers graph evidence, and a writer persists bounded memory updates when needed. On a fresh install the first session auto-enters initiate mode (language, intro, seed people/focus, light SOUL overlay, initiation receipt). v0.3+ adds typed quality sensors (FEEDBACK), harness generation pins, and a guided report-only maintenance skill (/digital-brain-dream) with a capability-fenced maintainer worker — activation stays on operator scripts only. v0.5+ requires a durable quality-plane gotcha after correction FEEDBACK (gotcha staged line; never journal-as-gotcha).
